definitions.explanation: The act of committing a crime. Refers to the criminal deed itself, including the manner, timing, and circumstances of how it was carried out. Frequently used in police investigations and news reporting.

examples.japanese: {犯行|はんこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深夜|しんや}→深夜：00368_shinya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The crime was committed late at night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{犯行|はんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べている→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: The police are investigating the motive for the crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}カメラ→防犯カメラ：07137_bouhankamera⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{犯行|はんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{映|うつ}っていた→映る：12964_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: The moment of the crime was captured on the security camera.

notes:
USAGE:
A news and legal term heard frequently in crime reporting. Describes the criminal act itself, not the crime as an abstract legal category (⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧) or the criminal (⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧). Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{反抗|はんこう}→反抗：03568_hankou⟧ (resistance, defiance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯行|はんこう}⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧: crime scene
- {犯行|はんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧: motive for the crime
- {犯行|はんこう}⟦{時刻|じこく}→時刻：03270_jikoku⟧: time of the crime
- {犯行|はんこう}⟦{声明|せいめい}→声明：03763_seimei⟧: statement claiming responsibility
- {犯行|はんこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{及|およ}ぶ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧: to carry out a crime
